_comment: "{t}, destroy a GOLD you control: Create a Goldkiss Rum token." Same defect as Raise an Army: 'asset' is not a key the DESTROY_PERMANENT cost reads, so the ability was activatable with no Gold and paying it destroyed an arbitrary permanent. The {t} half of the cost was missing entirely and the activation cost was 1 where the card charges no resources -- it costs a tap and a Gold.
